page.overview:
Who is Caluandr?

Caluandr of Cothique was a High Elf archmage who had studied the Scrolls of Kadon and mastered magical control of monstrous beasts, but was killed after trying to control a Magma Dragon in Tor Karyndis. Now, his apprentice, the High Elf mage Kyraelle Palemoon, is trying to surpass her mentor.

Caluandr was one of the few among his people to have studied the workings of the primitive Scrolls of Binding of Kadon the Shackler. Such was his knowledge of this type of magic that Caluandr could summon the bound monsters at great distances ready to ambush his unfortunate enemies.

The archmage died during the siege of Tor Karyndis, slain by the immense Magma Dragon he dared to summon to slay the besieging Skaven army. Such was the power of Caluandr that some legend says that the Dragon is still bound to the area where it was summoned that day.

"Caluandr" is misspelled "Calaundr" in Warhammer Fantasy Roleplay 4th Edition: Sea Wardens of Cothique.
